title: Seabreeze Hideaway | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away in a quiet La Jolla neighborhood, Seabreeze Hideaway is a coastal retreat designed for relaxation and connection. This beautifully styled three-bedroom home blends laid-back elegance with thoughtful functionality, offering flexible sleeping arrangements for up to eight guests. The airy open floor plan, coastal-chic décor, and well-equipped kitchen create a welcoming environment for everything from slow mornings to festive dinners. Just minutes from world-class beaches, boutique shopping, and acclaimed dining, it’s perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of La Jolla while feeling worlds away. Step outside into a private backyard oasis where everyday moments feel elevated. A bubbling hot tub, cozy fire pit, and shaded al fresco dining area with BBQ invite easygoing afternoons and sunset evenings under the stars. Whether gathering with family, reconnecting with friends, or simply taking time to unwind, every space at Seabreeze Hideaway is designed to inspire effortless enjoyment. With a two-car garage, extra driveway parking, and the beach close by, this retreat offers a seamless blend of convenience, style, and Southern California charm.
